recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any further editorial polish for PaymentReconciliation descriptions should be handled as a new current-version FM issue rather than by reapplying the STU3 FHIR-18004 wording verbatim.
issue_request: FHIR-18004 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 by FM and requested long-description updates for PaymentReconciliation.organization, outcome, disposition, requestProvider, and detail request/response/submitted/payee.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed source commit for FHIR-18004 was found. The surrounding STU3-to-R4 PaymentReconciliation work was applied as modified: FHIR-17995 and FHIR-17996 renamed organization to paymentIssuer and requestProvider to requestor, fhir.ini carries those aliases, and R4/R4B/R5/current source uses modified descriptions rather than the exact Jira prose.
additional_context: FHIR-26601 later moved detail to allocation and expanded PaymentReconciliation for patient payments. FHIR-22689 later clarified requestor as the provider/party responsible for the request and accountable for claim data content, so restoring the old target-of-payment wording would conflict with later applied current-source context.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active StructureDefinition definitions for paymentIssuer, requestor, outcome, disposition, allocation.target, allocation.response, allocation.submitter, and allocation.payee already convey the approved semantics after later renames and scope changes.
